class.name: GDScriptMethodDescriptor
class.brief_description: A read-only structured descriptor for a single reflected [GDScript] method.
class.description: Describes one method declared by a [GDScript] type or its base scripts, as a typed alternative to the loosely-keyed [Dictionary] entries of [method GDScriptReflection.get_methods]. Instances are produced by [method GDScriptReflection.get_method_descriptors] and [method GDScriptReflection.get_method_descriptor] and are immutable snapshots of the compiled method metadata. Beyond the [method Object.get_method_list] fields it mirrors ([member name], [member args], [member return_value], [member default_args], and [member flags]), each descriptor carries the method's passive [member annotations]. The accessors return copies, so mutating them does not change the script's stored metadata. Use [method to_dictionary] to obtain the equivalent loosely-keyed descriptor [Dictionary].

method.name: to_dictionary
method.description: Returns the equivalent loosely-keyed method descriptor [Dictionary], matching the entries of [method GDScriptReflection.get_methods]: an [method Object.get_method_list] [Dictionary] plus an [code]"annotations"[/code] key holding the [member annotations].

members.member: The passive annotations applied to the method, in source order, as [GDScriptAnnotation] descriptors. Empty when the method has no annotations. Each call returns an independent snapshot.
The method's parameter descriptors, in declaration order, each in the same [Dictionary] shape as an [method Object.get_method_list] argument.
The trailing default argument values declared for the method, in declaration order.
The method's flags, a bitmask of [enum MethodFlags] values.
The method's return value descriptor, in the same [Dictionary] shape as an [method Object.get_method_list] return value.
